schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Non-major updates: one weekly PR, auto-merged once CI is green
Major updates: listed on the Dependency Dashboard; a PR is opened only after ticking its checkbox

Pins, digest pins and lock-file maintenance carry no release timestamp, and Renovate >= 42 treats a missing timestamp as 'not old enough', so with minimumReleaseAge the renovate/stability-days status stays pending forever on those PRs (seen 2026-10-05..08). Exempt only these update types; real version updates still wait 3 days

GitHub Actions digest moves (a pinned sha following its floating major tag) age against the tag's timestamp, which the datasource does not provide, so renovate/stability-days stayed pending on a digest from 2026-09-01 even after the pin/lockfile exemption (hawk90.github.io#34, re-evaluated 2026-10-08). Exempt them too; the protection for actions is the sha pin plus CI, not the wait
Rust toolchain pin (rust-toolchain.toml): manual, one PR per release
dtolnay/rust-toolchain: the tag is the MSRV pin (e.g. @1.95), not an action release

customManagers.description: Bump the pinned channel in rust-toolchain.toml
